Ravi Kalia

© 2026 Ravi Kalia. All rights reserved.

First edition, November 2026. Built from the source in `book/` of the
[workshop repository](https://github.com/project-delphi/quarto-workshop) on GitHub. Read the [website edition](https://project-delphi.github.io/quarto-workshop/book/) online.

Checked with Quarto 1.10.20 (Typst 0.15), Python 3.12 and uv. Prices, versions, screens and
plans described in this book were checked on the dates given in the text and will change.

**Data and images.** London visit counts: Association of Leading Visitor Attractions (ALVA).
Place coordinates: Wikidata (CC0). London borough boundaries: Office for National Statistics,
Open Government Licence v3.0, contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2024.
Colombian data: Instituto Nacional de Salud, DANE, ICFES, Ministerio de Educación Nacional and
DNP, through datos.gov.co and TerriData; rainfall from CHIRPS and altitude from NASA SRTM.
Photographs: Wikimedia Commons, credited where they appear. Pelican drawings: Simon Willison's
pelican series, credited and linked where they appear. Every source, licence and retrieval
date is listed in @sec-sources.

Product names, including Quarto, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, GPT, Antigravity and Gemini,
belong to their owners. Their mention describes the tools used and implies no endorsement.

**AI usage statement.** This book was written with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), which drafted
the chapters, code, diagrams and media scripts and rendered both editions, adapting the
workshop slides, which were themselves written with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5,
Opus 5 and Fable 5.1). Every number drawn from the two projects' data is computed from that data when
the book is built; prices, timings and other facts that change are cited with the date they
were checked. The author directed the work and takes full responsibility for the content.
